title: Positive scalar curvature Kähler cones on compact complex surfaces
summary: We determine the positive scalar curvature Kähler cone of every minimal compact Kähler surface of Kodaira dimension $-\infty$. By the Enriques--Kodaira classification, every such surface is either $\mathbb P^2$ or a geometrically ruled surface $\mathbb P(E)\toΣ_g$, where $E$ is a rank-two holomorphic vector bundle over a compact Riemann surface of genus $g$.
